artifacts.summary: Universal cover of a one-step relation as reduced walks: oriented forest, doubly serial, surjective and TwoWayBounded endpoint projection, with L-plus truth transfer.

completion_data.completion_summary: Landed the universal cover of a one-step relation as a dependently-indexed inductive of reduced walks in the new module FormalSystem/Semantics/UniversalCover.lean: coverStep_isOrientedForest discharges all three IsOrientedForest fields (acyclicity through the new ForMathlib criterion SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_of_rank_parent, never through Walk.IsCycle), the two one-step lifts give double seriality, and endpt_twoWayBounded plus endpt_surjective feed TwoWayBounded.plus_invariance_of_isZTime to yield the headline exists_orientedForest_cover. Also added FrameOver.ofStepSat, the Saturation-parameterised sibling of ofStep, since the cover carrier is infinite whenever the base has an edge. All seven plan phases complete, sorry-free and axiom-clean, with a green full lake build and lake test.
roadmap_items: ROADMAP hypothesis (H5), second half: the universal cover of a doubly serial digraph is an oriented forest with a surjective, two-way bounded covering map
